title: Explained: What are rolling returns in mutual funds and how do you calculate them?
raw_summary: Rolling returns serve as a valuable tool for investors to assess mutual fund performance by averaging annualized returns over several timeframes. Unlike trailing returns that might reflect a distorted perspective, rolling returns utilize daily NAV data to provide a holistic view. By applying a CAGR formula, investors can evaluate consistency and adaptability of funds across diverse market conditions, making informed decisions easier and more precise.
